player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration with "DONE" while still in the Closet, which had an unvisited "west" direction available. My mistake was failing to exhaust all available directions in the current room before declaring the task complete. Next time, I will strictly follow a depth-first or breadth-first traversal strategy: I must continue moving in any available direction (e.g., going west from the Closet) until I reach a room where all directions lead to already visited nodes. Only when no new rooms can be reached from the current location and the graph is fully connected will I output "DONE". Additionally, I will ensure the graph's "edges" are updated correctly to reflect the bidirectional nature of the connections as I traverse them.
